Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square seamless repeatable ground-material texture for the painted urban streets of a 3/4 isometric zombie action game.
Primary request: one production-ready hand-painted dark charcoal and green-gray wet cracked asphalt surface tile, square composition. View straight down, true top-down orthographic surface study. The entire image is the same continuous asphalt material, edge to edge, with repeat-friendly opposite edges.
Style/medium: restrained illustrated game environment material, brush-painted granular aggregate, small rough stone flecks, subtle scuffs, thin irregular hairline crack networks, shallow low-contrast puddles. Painted tactile detail with quiet value variation, not a photorealistic macro shot.
Color palette: dark charcoal, desaturated blue-green gray, faint muted moss-gray; narrow low-contrast luminance range so gameplay silhouettes and amber/cyan combat effects remain clear.
Lighting: completely diffuse and uniform. No directional baked lighting, shadows, perspective, horizon, bright reflected light sources or highlight hotspots.
Composition: evenly distributed small details, no central focal point, no large unique cracks or recognizable landmark shapes. Seamless tiling material rather than a scene. Tiny shallow puddles occupy only a restrained minority of the area and blend naturally into worn asphalt.
Constraints: opaque background. No road stripes, lane markings, sidewalks, people, buildings, vehicles, props, debris objects, signs, lettering, numbers, text, logos, borders or watermark. No big distinctive landmarks. Do not render a perspective view. Produce exactly one square texture tile.
